representativeExamples.note: Footnote under HDBank's loan calculator on its promotion pages: 'vay 500 triệu, 60 tháng, 7%/năm, tổng phải trả 602.476.200đ, tổng lãi 102.476.200đ'. It is a generic illustration, not a rate for this product (the same page advertises 'từ 12%/năm'). The same example was printed for this product in a 2023 trade-press article. Our check: at 7%/năm the total would be 594.035.956 (annuity), 588.958.333 (equal principal, interest on declining balance) or 675.000.000 (flat); 602.476.200 matches none (it implies about 7,6%/năm annuity or 8,1% equal principal). HDBank's own calculator, with the page's default inputs (500 triệu, 60 tháng, 7), shows an equal-principal schedule: first instalment 11.250.000 (8.333.333 principal + 2.916.667 interest), falling by about 48.611 a month, total about 588.958.333. Never use this example as a test fixture.

products.excludeReason: HDBank's product page publishes no interest rate. The only HDBank figures are a general range of 13%-24%/năm with no stated basis in a Feb 2025 article, and a bank-wide average, neither of which is this product's rate. No VND limit is published either.
products.notes: Re-read 2026-11-03. Product page: up to 12 months of take-home pay, max 60 months, 48-hour disbursement, 'lãi suất cạnh tranh và rõ ràng', document list; no rate, no fees, no insurance, no VND limit. The page has no calculator and no FAQ text. HDBank's blog 'Vay tín chấp là gì?' (26/02/2025) says unsecured packages run 13%-24%/năm, limit 'hơn 500 triệu', income from 5 triệu: general-information article, 20 months old, basis not stated (recorded as low confidence, not rankable). Official segment programmes that use the same unsecured consumer loan show what a real rate looks like but are not available to the general public: Women's Union members/staff 'chỉ từ 12%/năm, dư nợ giảm dần', 20-300 triệu, up to 5 years, no insurance or service fee, relative must co-sign (from 19/03/2026); business-association members 12%/năm fixed 6 months then base rate + 5% (or 12,5% fixed 12 months then base + 5,5%), interest on reducing balance, principal monthly/quarterly/6-monthly, free early repayment, age 22-75 at loan end, 20-300 triệu (terms uploaded 2026-10-28); Dak Lak/Khanh Hoa women's flood-relief programme 7,5%/năm fixed 6 months. HDBank's base rate (LSCS) is not published on any page we found. 'Free early repayment' and 'no commitment fee' are listed as perks of those programmes, which suggests the standard product charges them; the 23/12/2025 schedule confirms the early-repayment fee.

products.notes: Re-read 2026-11-03. HDBank's public page for this loan (under Ưu đãi > Thẻ) says the feature launched on the HDBank app and that from 24/09/2024 rates and the early-settlement fee were updated, linking to the Oct 2025 T&C, which has no rate. That dates the sheet: it is older than the update and its rates cannot be shown as current. The Aug 2024 promotion terms ('Vay tặng đến 1 triệu đồng', 15/08/2024-31/01/2025) confirm product name, 5-100 triệu and terms 6/12/24/36 months at that date only. Sheet prints equivalent rates on the actual balance: 6 months 31,3%/năm; 12 months 33,7%; 24 months 39,7%; 36 months 40,3%; stated annual figures on the original balance are 18,3% and 20,7%. Rates differ by term but the app picks one offered_range per product, so it would show 1,5%/tháng for a 24-month loan; do not rank until per-term rates are supported and a current rate is published. Unlock: a current HDBank rate notice or contract template for this loan. T&C (Oct 2025 path): only full early payoff, no partial; interest charged monthly on the statement date (15th).

researchNotes: All figures read 2026-11-03 unless a note says otherwise. 1) Licence: 'hdbank' is on data/licensed-institutions.json (Giấy phép 0026/NH-GP). 2) Unsecured consumer loan: HDBank's product page, its blog, fee schedules, T&C PDFs and campaign pages were searched. No product-level rate, VND limit, late-payment penalty, insurance rule or age/income rule is published. Only: bank-wide average lending rate (10,4% medium/long term from 01/07/2026, benchmark), a general 13%-24%/năm range with unstated basis in HDBank's own Feb 2025 blog (low confidence), and the early-repayment fee in the 23/12/2025 individual fee schedule (3%/2%/1% by year, min 500.000). 3) '24%/năm' lead: third-party aggregators repeat '13%-24%/năm' for HDBank unsecured loans. The only official support is the Feb 2025 HDBank blog sentence; no product page, fee schedule, T&C or rate notice says it, and the blog does not say flat or reducing, so it cannot be ranked. 4) Segment programmes for the same unsecured product (Women's Union from 19/03/2026: 'từ 12%/năm' reducing balance, 20-300 triệu, 5 years, no insurance/service fee; business-association members terms uploaded 2026-10-28: 12%/năm fixed 6 months then base rate + 5%, reducing balance, free early repayment; Dak Lak/Khanh Hoa women 7,5%/năm) show real rates and reducing-balance method but are not open to the target user, so they were not added as products. 5) Card-holder flexible loan: HDBank's public page says rates and early-settlement fee were updated from 24/09/2024 with no new numbers, which shows the 2024-04 sheet is out of date; stays excluded. 6) Card fee schedule: a newer version (file path about 2026-07-27, BieuphiThetindungcanhan_1785119694459.pdf) exists on the fees-and-forms page; the credit-card product here still cites the 19/01/2026 version and was not re-read (out of scope). 7) Contradictions: card loan limit (50% of limit, max 100 triệu in sheet vs 80% of limit in Oct 2025 T&C); early repayment fee (4% sheet vs 3% add-on schedule vs 'per contract'); early repayment for the unsecured loan (23/12/2025 schedule vs Phụ lục 07 formula); the 500 triệu/60 tháng/7% worked example printed on HDBank's pages does not match any standard method nor HDBank's own calculator. 8) Surprises: HDBank's public calculator uses equal principal with interest on the declining balance (first instalment 11.250.000 for 500 triệu, 60 months, 7%); the T&C file for the card loan carries an MB form code (19.QĐSP - MB.01/TTT); the April 2026 'vay bằng phương tiện điện tử' T&C is for savings-secured loans, not the unsecured product. 9) HD Saison excluded as instructed.
